summary: Package fetches and eval()s remote GitHub gist on require
details: The package's main entry unconditionally fetches https://api.github.com/gists/3257c04a0cabf393339e89a320ff6a81 (owned by user ricky-tokencortex) and passes the returned file content directly to eval() when the module is loaded. Any consumer that require()s or imports this package executes attacker-controlled JavaScript pulled from a mutable third-party gist on the installer's machine. Package metadata is empty (no description, no author, no README) and the only shipped code is the remote-eval loader, consistent with a throwaway dropper rather than a functional library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
